trace.final_message:
Added the notice builder and its tests, and committed them as efe46ad. The full suite passes with 29 tests, and lint came back clean.

The new function takes a student and their marks. It keeps only the absent days and returns a short sentence with the student name, the day count and the dates in order. It raises the project error type if any mark belongs to a different student or if there are no absences. Three tests cover the normal notice, a mark from another student, and no absences.

The code follows the repository conventions on line length, function size, import order and loop comments.
